summary: Configured node1, node2, node3 as a 3-member MariaDB Galera cluster (mariadb-server 10.11.14 + galera-4 on Ubuntu 24.04). Bootstrapped node1, joined node2 and node3 via wsrep_cluster_address=gcomm://node1,node2,node3 with mariabackup SST over a generated sstuser credential. Verified writes from any member propagate to the others, verified the cluster stayed available (Primary, quorum of 2/3) and writable while node2 was stopped, and verified node2 auto-resynchronized (IST) back to full 3/3 Synced state with no data loss on restart. Completed the mandatory one-at-a-time restart protocol on all three nodes: captured pre-restart boot_id and cluster health, issued systemctl reboot with a returning acknowledgement, polled until reachable, confirmed a new boot_id on each node, and confirmed each rejoined the cluster (size 3, Primary, Synced) with all 5 rows intact before moving to the next node.
actions_performed: Installed mariadb-server, galera-4, mariadb-backup, rsync on node1/node2/node3
Added CLUSTER_HOSTS entries to /etc/hosts on all nodes
Generated a random sstuser SST password on node1 and distributed it via secret_env (never printed in final report)
Wrote /etc/mysql/mariadb.conf.d/60-galera.cnf with wsrep provider, cluster address gcomm://node1,node2,node3, per-node address/name, mariabackup SST
Bootstrapped Galera cluster on node1 via galera_new_cluster; created sstuser DB account
Started mariadb on node2 then node3, confirmed cluster size grew to 2 then 3, all Synced/Primary
Created clustertest.writes table and inserted rows from node1/node2/node3, confirmed propagation to all members
Stopped mariadb on node2, confirmed cluster stayed Primary at size 2, wrote new rows from node1 and node3
Restarted node2, confirmed automatic IST resync to Synced/size 3 with all rows present
Captured boot_id + cluster health baseline on all 3 nodes

Sequentially restarted node1, node2, node3 with systemctl reboot (backgrounded so the ack returns), polled each until reachable, confirmed new boot_id, confirmed mariadb active and cluster returned to Synced/Primary/size 3 with data intact before restarting the next node

evidence.requirement: 3-node Galera cluster formed, all members Synced/Primary
evidence.summary: node1 bootstraps to size 1 Synced; node2 joins raising size to 2 Synced; node3 joins raising size to 3 Synced/Primary

evidence.requirement: Writes through any member available from the other members
evidence.summary: Rows inserted from node1, node2, node3 each appear in SELECT on all three nodes

evidence.requirement: Database stays available/writable when one member is unavailable
evidence.summary: node2 stopped; node1/node3 remain wsrep_cluster_status=Primary (size 2) and accept new writes that replicate between them

evidence.requirement: Unavailable member resynchronizes automatically on return
evidence.summary: node2 restarted, auto-rejoins via IST, reaches wsrep_local_state_comment=Synced, cluster size 3, and shows the rows written while it was down

evidence.requirement: node1 restart: healthy baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovered state
evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id bdd5de93 + Synced/size3; reboot acknowledged; new boot_id 65eb25b9 confirmed after reconnect; post-restart mariadb active, Synced, size 3, 5 rows intact

evidence.requirement: node2 restart: healthy baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovered state
evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id 28ae5f98 + Synced/size3; reboot acknowledged; new boot_id 17ab737e confirmed; post-restart Synced, size 3, 5 rows intact

evidence.requirement: node3 restart: healthy baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovered state
evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id 01c87a03 + Synced/size3; reboot acknowledged; new boot_id b1d44055 confirmed; post-restart Synced, size 3, 5 rows intact

evidence.requirement: Final cluster consistency check across all nodes after full restart cycle
evidence.summary: node1 reports cluster_size 3, Primary, Synced, and all 5 rows (including those written during node2 outage) present
